Counselor's Approval Do ONE Principle 3: Your Parent or Guardian's Permission Principle 3: Copper oxide canproduce a brilliantred in a reductionfiring, but it wouldproduce greens inan oxidation firing (p. 25).

step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 (Counselor's Approval Do ONE): Step 1 (Your Parent or Guardian's Permission): Thedampers in fuel-burning kilns enable the potter to adjust theamount of oxygen inside the kiln (p. 25).

Step 2 (Counselor's Approval Do ONE): Step 2 (Your Parent or Guardian's Permission): When the kiln contains morethan enough oxygen needed to completely burn the amount offuel being used, the atmosphere inside the kiln is oxidized (p. 25).

Step 3 (Counselor's Approval Do ONE): Step 3 (Your Parent or Guardian's Permission): In a reduction firing, the flame is seeking oxygen inside thekiln, and because there isn't enough, it "steals" oxygen from the clay and glazes (p. 25).
Step 4 (Counselor's Approval Do ONE): Step 4 (Your Parent or Guardian's Permission): This chemical reaction darkens the clay and changes the look and texture of some glazes (p. 25).
